metadata.source_revision: 2bef6914 plus an uncommitted per-cycle trace patch (patch_sha256)
metadata.build: CMake release preset, separate build directory, pinned Nix ROCm 7.2.3 toolchain
metadata.hardware: AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395 / Radeon 8060S gfx1151, 128 GB unified memory
metadata.arms: new = 422fbe4d dense verification prices (current); old = 519dfe9c dense prices selected at runtime in the same binary. Order new1, old1, old2, new2; fresh server per arm.
metadata.workload: Same HTTP sequence as mtp-attention-e2e-2026-10-20 default mode: 16-token warmup, cold ~31K-token summary400, essay400 (22,528-token prefix reuse), code-edit512; greedy seed 1, thinking off, context 40960, sessions 1, calibrated policy with shared calibration.
metadata.fields: pos = verified position; rows = pending + drafts + copies + siblings; acc = accepted chain drafts/copies; hit = accepted sibling; emit = tokens emitted; draft_ms = BeginCycle (drafter chain, lookup, policy, draft head) host wall; verify_ms = forward plus argmax readback; cycle_ms = DecodeStep entry to FinishCycle end; gap = previous cycle end to this cycle end; pd/pv = policy-priced drafter and verification ms; exp = expected tokens; stop/stop_est = signal and calibrated estimate of the draft the policy declined (-1: none); lhs/rhs = that decision (lhs < rhs stops); est/sig = kept drafts; sibest = included siblings' hit estimates.

findings.essay_gap_cycle: Cycle 56 at position 31463: both price tables keep the same seven drafts and stop at the same eighth (lhs 20.8/23.5 < rhs 51.4/70.5). Old prices add no sibling: 8 rows, 152.1/152.3 ms, one token emitted (the next cycle emits the following token). New prices add two siblings (hit estimate 0.97): 10 rows, 164.9/167.4 ms, a sibling accepted, two tokens emitted. Every other essay cycle stays at or below ~152.7 ms in both tables.
findings.essay_schedule: new 143 cycles, 116 siblings, 25 accepted; old 144 cycles, 107 siblings, 21 accepted; summed cycle time 19.05/19.25 s vs 19.35/19.36 s; decode 20.85/20.63 vs 20.53/20.52 tok/s; identical text.
findings.cost_accuracy: Measured/priced at ~31K, all requests and arms: verification 0.923-0.948 (per-request standard deviation 0.004-0.007, flat over 2-16 rows); drafter 1.111-1.143. Host time between cycles ~0.02 ms.
